## Sandbox Respository for Various Projects 

I am use the [Beginnersluck repository](https://github.com/marclos/Beginnersluck) repository to host various R and RStudio related projects including teaching materials, Shiny apps, and other R related resources. To see the various projects, please explore the repository folders.

You can also access all my repositories via [marclos](https://github.com/marclos).
